title: NsrR Represses sigma(E)-Dependent Small RNAs and Interacts with RpoE via a Noncanonical Mechanism in Escherichia coli.
authors: Aubee, Joseph I; Nurse, Jalisa; Lewis, Dale; Tai, Chin-Hsien; Thompson, Karl M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NsrR对sigma(E)依赖小RNA的抑制及与RpoE的非经典互作，涉及蛋白-DNA调控但非TF-DNA结合位点预测，AlphaFold3结构建模提供方法借鉴，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移。
abstract: The envelope stress response in Escherichia coli is primarily governed by the sigma factor RpoE (sigma(E)), which activates protective genes upon membrane perturbation. Under non-stress conditions, sigma(E) is sequestered by its anti-sigma factor RseA. In this study, we identify an unexpected role for the nitric-oxide-sensing repressor NsrR in dampening sigma(E) activity and repressing sigma(E)-dependent small RNAs, including rybB, micA, and micL. Overexpression of nsrR represses transcription from sigma(E)-dependent promoters and phenocopies sigma(E) inactivation, resulting in filamentous morphology and growth defects. Conversely, DeltansrR de-represses sigma(E) targets, with additive effects in rseA mutants-supporting an RseA-independent regulatory role. Time-course analysis shows NsrR represses sigma(E) activity, with kinetics comparable to those of RseA. While in vitro assays failed to detect robust NsrR binding to sigma(E) target promoters, NsrR directly interacts with sigma(E) in bacterial two-hybrid assays. Structural modeling using AlphaFold3 supports a plausible NsrR-RpoE interaction interface. These findings suggest that NsrR functions as a noncanonical anti-sigma-like modulator of sigma(E), integrating redox and envelope stress signals to maintain membrane homeostasis.
abstract_zh: 大肠杆菌中的包膜应激反应主要由sigma因子RpoE（sigma(E)）调控，该因子在膜扰动时激活保护性基因。在非应激条件下，sigma(E)被其抗sigma因子RseA所隔离。在本研究中，我们发现了氧化氮感应阻遏物NsrR在抑制sigma(E)活性及阻遏sigma(E)依赖性小RNA（包括rybB、micA和micL）方面的一个意外作用。过表达nsrR可抑制sigma(E)依赖性启动子的转录，并模拟sigma(E)失活表型，导致丝状形态和生长缺陷。相反，DeltansrR去阻遏sigma(E)靶标，并在rseA突变体中产生叠加效应——支持一种不依赖RseA的调控作用。时间过程分析显示，NsrR抑制sigma(E)活性，其动力学与RseA相当。虽然体外实验未能检测到NsrR对sigma(E)靶标启动子的强结合，但在细菌双杂交实验中，NsrR直接与sigma(E)相互作用。使用AlphaFold3的结构建模支持NsrR-RpoE相互作用的可能界面。这些发现表明，NsrR作为sigma(E)的非经典抗sigma样调节因子，整合氧化还原和包膜应激信号以维持膜稳态。
